stories.title: Italy, France, Isle of Man, Spain make winning starts
stories.subTitle: European Under-17 Championship Division Two
stories.seoTitle: Italy, France, Isle of Man, Spain make winning starts
stories.summary: Italy got to a winning start in the European Under-17 Division Two Championships with a thumping victory against Belgium. France, Spain and Isle of Man also registered wins on the opening day.
